run_eval_zoo: run eval_zoo to get the evaluation script and variables for a named dataset like h36m or pascal3d
run_eval_pascal3d: run eval_pascal3d to evaluate 3D error metrics on Pascal3D predictions with per-class results
run_eval_h36m: run eval_h36m to evaluate 3D pose predictions on the Human3.6M dataset with per-action breakdown
run_calc_3d_errs: run calc_3d_errs to compute MPJPE and stress error metrics between predicted and ground truth 3D keypoints
run_calc_stress_err: run calc_stress_err to compute the stress error comparing pairwise Euclidean distance matrices of predicted and ground truth keypoints
